def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - np.minimum(bins, item)
    # Avoid division by zero and ensure bins with no remaining capacity get lowest priority
    remaining = np.where(remaining == 0, 1e-10, remaining)
    # Prioritize bins with higher remaining capacity relative to total capacity
    # Use inverse of remaining capacity ratio to prioritize bins with more space
    priorities = 1 / remaining
    # Normalize priorities so that larger values mean higher priority
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    # Avoid negative or zero remaining capacity by clamping to small positive value
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 1e-8)
    # Prioritize bins with more remaining capacity
    return remaining
